visual-studio-load-test.about: Microsoft Visual Studio Load Test was the web performance and load-testing capability in Visual Studio, paired with Azure DevOps cloud-based load testing and/or on-premises Test Controller/Test Agent infrastructure. Command-line and CI/build integration through mstest.exe and Azure DevOps build tasks.
